8小时后，凌晨两点。

厉雨骤然惊醒，身体猛地向上一跳，仿佛是心脏骤停后重新复苏的病人一样。

脚下的凳子被他带得蹦了起来，砸在地上发出“砰”地一声巨响。

失去平衡的他下意识想要伸手去撑地，但却发现自己的两只手动弹不得。

又是一声巨响，他连通凳子一起侧倒在地上，脑袋撞击瓷砖地面，刚刚醒来的他又是一阵天旋地转。

“卧槽......”

“这他妈什么情况......”

自己明明已经找到那个人了，手里的蛊丸马上就要出手了！

可自己的记忆，也就在自己跟他对视的那一瞬间就消失了。

再睁开眼......

这他妈到底是哪儿？！

厉雨拼命挣扎，一片黑暗中，有一个声音突然响起。

“别动。”

这声音中透着一丝冷意，让厉雨瞬间安静下来。

完了。

就他么知道这80万不好挣！

这下恐怕是......招惹到真神了！

开什么玩笑！

那小子明明就是个平平无奇的普通人！

他怎么能提前动手制住自己？他怎么能察觉的？

还是说.......

他身上有五猖护法？！

五猖......这玩意儿听说过没见过。

可自己的蛊毒是真的，那很显然，五猖法也很可能是真的了......

这下是真完了......

“大师！大师！”

厉雨的声音里已经带上了几分哭腔。

“我错了！什么也瞒不住你，但我也是受奸人蛊惑！”

“他们就是想让我跟你找点小麻烦，就是一点小麻烦而已啊！”

“我还没动手，放过我，放过我啊！”

厉雨拼命正过身子来，似乎是想要在地上磕头。

但他被林舒绑的死死的，像是一条被弓住的鱼，压根动不了一点。

看着他近乎癫狂的动作，林舒心里那点不安、或者说愧疚也彻底消散了。

找点小麻烦？

小麻烦是你这样找的？

你不是想找麻烦，你是想杀我。

被我撞破之后，你还要在我面前撒谎......

那我就，没必要对你客气了。

“你想用蛊术杀我。”

林舒一语道破，那男人的动作瞬间一滞，但转而又继续狡辩。

Eight hours later, it’s two o’clock in the morning.

Li Yu woke up suddenly, and his body jumped upwards, as if he was a patient resuscitating after a cardiac arrest.

The stool under his feet jumped up and hit the ground with a loud bang.

Losing his balance, he subconsciously wanted to reach out to support the ground, but found that his two hands could not move.

There was another loud noise, and he fell sideways to the ground with the stool, and his head hit the tile floor. He had just woken up and was spinning again.

"Fuck..."

"What the hell is going on..."

He has obviously found that person, and the Gu Pill in his hand is about to be released!

But his memory disappeared the moment he looked at him.

Open your eyes again...

Where the hell is this?!

Li Yu struggled desperately, and in the darkness, a voice suddenly sounded.

"Don't move."

There was a hint of coldness in this voice, which made Li Yu calm down instantly.

It's over.

He is the only one who knows that 800,000 yuan is not easy to earn!

This time I'm afraid... I've provoked the true god!

What a joke!

That kid is obviously an ordinary person!

How could he stop himself in advance?How could he detect it?

Or should I say...

Does he have the Five Rampant Protectors on him?!

Wu Ram... I have never heard of this thing, but I have never seen it.

But if his poison is real, it is obvious that the Five Rampant Methods are also likely to be real...

It's really over now...

"Master! Master!"

Li Yu's voice already had a hint of crying.

"I was wrong! I can't hide anything from you, but I was also bewitched by an adulterer!"

"They just want me to cause a little trouble with you, just a little trouble!"

"I haven't done anything yet, let me go, let me go!"

Li Yu tried his best to turn around, as if he wanted to kowtow on the ground.

But he was tied tightly by Lin Shu, like a fish trapped in a bow, unable to move at all.

Seeing his almost crazy movements, the uneasiness or guilt in Lin Shu's heart completely dissipated.

Looking for a little trouble?

Is this how you brought this little trouble?

You're not trying to cause trouble, you're trying to kill me.

After being exposed by me, you still lie in front of me...

Then I don't need to be polite to you.

"You want to use voodoo to kill me."

Lin Shu made the point. The man's movements froze for a moment, but then he continued to quibble.
